name: Activate evacuation plan
description: Decide to evacuate based on pre-agreed triggers or official guidance.

name: Grab bags
description: Collect go-bags for each person and dependent.

name: Documents
description: Collect IDs, insurance, medical documents, cash, contacts, and property records.

name: Pets and dependents
description: Load carriers, leashes, medication, comfort items, special equipment, and dependent supplies.
completion_evidence: All dependents and pets accounted for

name: Medication
description: Pack medications, prescriptions, medical devices, chargers, and health notes.

name: Route
description: Choose primary or backup route based on current hazards and shared road reports.
notes: Avoid publishing sensitive route details to broad groups.

name: Destination
description: Confirm destination, contact, and ETA before departure.
notes: Use destination alias if privacy is needed.

name: Contact check-in
description: Send departure status to trusted circle with route/destination details only as appropriate.
completion_evidence: Departure message sent and response/ACK tracked
notes: Include who is with you and who still needs help.

name: Secure home
description: Shut off or secure items according to the hazard and time available.
completion_evidence: Home secured as much as safely possible
notes: Do not delay departure for noncritical tasks.

name: En route updates
description: Send brief updates only when stopped or safe, especially for route changes, hazards, or delays.

name: Arrival confirmation
description: Confirm arrival, safety, supply status, medical status, and remaining needs.
completion_evidence: Arrival confirmed and dashboard status updated
